csv_project_name: Consultant for Safe Streets for All SS4A Planning
csv_scope_of_work: DeKalb County Government (the County) seeks electronic proposals for Solicitation No. 2026-002-RFP Safe Streets for All (SS4A): Planning and Demonstration (Three (3) Year Multiyear Contract) from planning and/or engineering firms to develop a Safety Action Plan and implement demonstration activities for unincorporated DeKalb County. DeKalb County Government seeks to develop a comprehensive Safe Streets for All (SS4A) Safety Action Plan and implement demonstration activities for unincorporated DeKalb County to reduce and eliminate traffic related fatalities and serious injuries for all roadway users. The project will apply a data-driven and systemic safety approach consistent with the U.S. Department of Transportation s Safe System principles, with particular emphasis on improving safety outcomes for vulnerable road users and communities disproportionately impacted by traffic crashes
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
